verdict.rationale: Bugbot automatically reviews every PR, but the evidence only shows it posting bug, security and code-quality findings as inline comments with suggested fixes. Nothing in the pack documents an auto-generated PR summary or a change walkthrough for human reviewers. Bug-finding comments are an adjacent feature and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a developer, every PR gets an auto-generated summary and change walkthrough so human reviewers orient fast
